colonel kishi.name: Colonel Kishi
colonel kishi.origin: Colonel Kishi was a member of the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. In the summer of 1944, he and his men smuggled themselves into Canada where they set up a mortar cannon to fire bombs across the river to destroy key targets in Detroit. As planned, the American military presumed that the attacks were caused by bombers, but no evidence of planes could ever be found. Kishi's operation was discovered thanks to the quick thinking of reporter Betty Dean and her friend the Sub-Mariner. Tracking the bombs trajectory to somewhere along the Canadian boarder, the Sub-Mariner swam across Lake Huron and was captured by Kishi's men. Namor and a local fur trapper named Francois were then freed by Betty Dean and located the cannon. Captured again, both Betty and Namor were strapped to the barrel of the cannon to be killed by the next shot. However, a sudden rain revitalized Namor who was able to break himself and Betty free. Taking control of the cannon, Namor then turned it on Colonel Kishi and his men killing them with a bomb blast.
weapons: Colonel Kishi had a massive cannon that could fire bombs across the river between Ontario and Michigan.

colonel myrdden.name: Colonel Myrdden
colonel myrdden.origin: The man known as Colonel Myrdden was a spell-man for hire, a "snatch-and-grab" lowlife. He and his team of mercenaries invaded Doctor Strange's Sanctum Sanctorum while he was off-world to steal the Book of Morphesti for an unrevealed third party. After acquiring the desired item, he decided to open it, entering a state of paralysis, and unleashing a spell that mutated everyone in the vicinity. With the help of Spider-Man and Pavel Rasputin, S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Phil Coulson explored the Sanctum Sanctorum and finally found Myrdden in the last floor. While slowly being affected by the book and transforming into a monster, Coulson managed to snatch the book from Myrdden's hands and close it, putting an end to the crisis. Colonel Myrdden was left in the state of paralysis even after the book was taken from him.

colonel rand.name: Colonel Rand
colonel rand.origin: thumb|left|Colonel Rand's true face Colonel Rand was an officer that was assigned to an important defense team which included Colonel Howard and Major Collins. For reasons of his own, Rand developed the identity of the Mad Artist. Using a specially designed paint that compelled others to do his bidding and wearing a false-face gas mask, he painted portraits of his colleagues in gruesome situations. He then invited Howard and Collins to his private studio to see his works. First, he painted a picture of Howard being struck by lightning. Inviting Howard over to see the painting, the effects of the paint made Howard go out during a rainstorm and purposely get struck by lightning. Later, he painted a portrait of Collins hanging himself from a lamp post. Showing this painting to Collins prompted Collins to do just that. Unfortunately for Rand, these strange deaths attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky who made a connection between the two upon finding paint on both the bodies. Believing that Colonel Rand was the next target, the two heroes staked out his house. The Mad Artist learned of this and had a note delivered to the two heroes enticing them to come to his private studio to learn the fate of Colonel Rand. There, Cap and Bucky would be horrified when the Painter unveiled a painting of Captain America stabbing himself. The Painter then handed Cap a knife, and he almost stabbed himself to death except for the intervention of Bucky. The two heroes then fought the Painter into submission. After his defeat, the Painter revealed his secrets to killing the military officers and then, not wishing to be taken alive, sniffed some of his own paint and died. Unmasked, Captain America and Bucky were shocked to learn that the Painter was none other than Colonel Rand himself. While Captain America speculated that Rand was a spy, his true motivations are unrevealed.

colonel schutter.name: Colonel Schutter
colonel schutter.origin: Colonel Schutter was a member of the Nazis active during World War II. By the winter of 1943 he was holding rank of colonel and a member of the Gestapo operating in Germany. When his superiors planned an invasion of Switzerland, he suggested eliminating the Destroyer before they carried out the operation and suggested that they spread false news about a planned invasion of Britain to draw the hero out of hiding. The plan worked, and a Destroyer broke into a Gestapo headquarters in Brest and walked right into Schutter's trap. However, the hero found paperwork about the real invasion planned for Switzerland and managed to escape. Schutter left his men to capture the hero and traveled to the Switzerland boarder to begin the invasion. The Destroyer avoided capture and followed Schutter and his men there. When Schutter spotted the hero stealing TNT from their supply shack, Schutter ordered his men to stand down and went to deal with the hero personally. Schutter was no match for the Destroyer in hand-to-hand combat and the hero bound him up and stole his tank. Taking Schutter with him, the Destroyer left his guard down allowing Schutter to escape from his bonds and attack the hero as he drove the tank. Focusing on Schutter, the Destroyer could not prevent the tank from speeding toward the supply shack full of TNT. However, the Destroyer soon noticed, knocked out Schutter and bailed out of the tank. The Destroyer then witnessed as the tank (followed by the rest of Schutter's minions) crashed into the shack, causing a massive explosion that killed Schutter and his men.

colonel strauheim.name: Colonel Strauheim
colonel strauheim.origin: Colonel Strauheim was a member of the Nazis during World War II. Despite his dwarfish size, he made it to the rank of Colonel in the Nazis, and by 1944 was stationed at a secret airfield in Brazil. There, he had a full team of scientists that created explosives, chemical weapons, as well as a weapon that apparently used radioactive beams that enlarged microscopic particles in gasoline to cause aircraft engines to fail. He also created a room in which he placed his prisoners where they would be attacked by a compliment of hungry vultures. Using the radioactive device to force airplanes to land on his airfield, Strauheim then removed any military secrets and important equipment then placed the pilots and crew to die at the hands of his vultures. However, the missing planes soon prompted military intelligence to send the Human Torch and Toro to investigate. Following a trail of cargo dumped by the last plane to go missing, the two flaming heroes found Colonel Strauheim's base. Strauheim ordered his men to use massive sprinklers to douse the two heroes flames, but this failed. Climbing up a gun tower, Strauheim attempted to put out the Torch's flames with a fire hose but was knocked off the tower by the Torch himself and fell to his death.
weapons: Strauheim had access to fire arms, explosives, poison gasses, and had a number of vultures trained to attack and kill human targets.

colonel tusker.name: Colonel Tusker
colonel tusker.origin: When the insane reality-warping mutant Mad Jim Jaspers took over the government of the Great Britain of Earth-238. Mad Jim Jaspers began persecuting other costumed paranormal individuals, having them hunted down and executed in order to make Britain a more safer place to live. After they became outlawed fugitives he joined the fight against the oppressive regime running Britain and was among the group that were hiding in a secret location when the Fury attacked and began slaughtering everyone there, including Colonel Tusker, who launched his full army of "killer toys" against the Fury. The Fury shrugged off the attack and killed Colonel Tusker. Other people slaughtered by the Fury are, Kid Miracleman, Iron Tallon, Bash Street Bunty, the Crusader, Gaath, the Puppetman, Captain Roy Risk, the Arachnid, Android Andy, Tom Rosetta, Miracleman and Young Miracleman. Captain UK was the only surviving hero on that day thanks to her husband, Rick, sending her away in a Ghost Box. His remains were buried in a superhero graveyard, and years later Captain Britain passed by his tombstone.
powers: Super-Genius Level Intellect
abilities: Incredibly smart for a boy his age.

colonel von bitters.name: Colonel von Bitters
colonel von bitters.origin: Colonel von Bitters was a member of the Nazis during World War II. Following the Nazi occupation of France, he and his troops were stationed in the small town of Blanc along the French-Swiss border. A constant thorn in his side was Free French resistance fighter Frank Piraud. In the fall of 1943, Von Bitters' men captured Frank's sister Ruth and forced her to write a letter telling his brother to surrender, or Von Bitters and his men would wipe out the entire town. He then forced Ruth to entertain him and his men by preparing dinner for a party he was throwing. Unknown to von Bitters, his messenger was intercepted by the Destroyer who organized Frank Piraud and his men to rescue Ruth. While von Bitters "entertained" Ruth in her room, the Destroyer, Frank, and the other rebels posed as waiters and gunned down the Colonel's men. Storming in on von Bitters, the Destroyer and Frank knocked him out. The Destroyer then disguised himself as von Bitters and ordered all the Nazi soldiers in the area to storm the resistance hideout. Unknown to the Nazi soldiers, the hideout was rigged with explosives and upon their arrival, Frank set them off killing all the Nazis. While Von Bitters' entire unit was wiped out and Blanc retaken by the resistance fighters, the Colonel's personal fate is unknown.

colonel yama.name: Colonel Yama
colonel yama.origin: Colonel Yama was a member of the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. Shortly after America entered the war, following the attack on Pearl Harbor, Yama was sent to wipe out Wake Island. There, he clashed with the US Navy, taking a number of the soldiers hostage and wiping out the town. A secret prison was built under the city where the soldiers were kept prisoner. Among them were Lloyd, Jerry, and Frank Dean, the brothers of New York City police woman Betty Dean. Betty went searching for her lost brothers with her ally Namor the Sub-Mariner. Finding the secret prison, Namor and his fellow Atlantean warriors clashed with Colonel Yama and his forces. During the fight, Yama fled the scene in a bomber. His desertion led to Namor retaking Wake Island and freeing the prisoners. Yama arrived shortly after over Guam just as Namor and his forces attacked there as well. Realizing the source of the sneak attack, Yama ordered his men to fire into the water, causing casualties on Namor's side. The Sub-Mariner then boarded Yama's bomber and forced the Colonel to bomb his own troops. Afterward, Namor then pushed Yama out of the plane to his death before fleeing himself. Yama's forces were soon defeated thanks to the timely arrival of the US Navy.
weapons: Yama was armed with a pistol.

colonel zinzer.name: Colonel Zinzer
colonel zinzer.origin: Colonel Zinzer was part of military intelligence for the Nazis during World War II. By the fall of 1942, he was sent to New Guinea to convince the local headhunter tribes to distrust all Caucasians (except Zinzer himself) and worship the incoming Imperial Japanese fleet as gods. Shortly after accomplishing this, reporters Jeff Mace, Jack Casey, and Mary Morgan arrived on the island to investigate reports that the Japanese were planning an invasion of the island. They were all captured by the headhunters, and Jeff was separated from Jack and Mary. Jeff was met by Colonel Zinzer who explained his entire plan and told Jeff that after the Japanese landed they would be eliminated. Left alone, Jeff broke free of his bonds and changed into the Patriot. Attacking the headhunters, the Patriot took one of their spears and hurled it at Zinzer. The spear impaled Zinzer through the chest, killing him instantly. This show of force convinced the leader of the headhunters to do whatever the Patriot asked of him, and he convinced them to help fight off the Japanese and free his friends.

colosso ape.name: Colosso (Ape)
colosso ape.origin: Colosso was an ape that was the star attraction of the Farnsworth-Stone Three Ring Circus. In May of 1943, the ape escaped, leading Deadline Dawson to be assigned to try and find out where the ape went. To his dismay, Deadline's friend boy detective Terry Vance was too busy preparing for his high school's big basketball championship game to help find the missing gorilla. Surprisingly enough, the ape sought refuge in the bell tower of Terry's high school. When the game was won, Terry and Deadline went to investigate who was ringing the bell excessively and found the missing gorilla. Terry's pet monkey Dr. Watson knocked Colosso out with the bell, and the ape was returned to the circus. In thanks for Terry's returning the ape, the owner of the circus gave Terry a reward of $500 which Terry invested on war bonds.

colossus vegan.origin: Agent 7M was sent from Vega Superior to scout Earth as a planet for potential conquest. His ship landed on a sheer mountain peak in Bora-Buru, Africa, on which he remained stranded. He was worshipped by the natives as a god. He was defeated by the two super heroes, after which he headed back to Vega Superior, warning his superiors of the humans' powers.

colossusus.name: Colossusus
colossusus.species: Artificial being created by Mojo from neoplasm to replace the original X-Men
colossusus.origin: Colossussus was one of the X-Babies created by Mojo from neoplasm to replace the original X-Men, whose death had caused a drop in ratings. Mojo was going to destroy them, but the X-Babies escaped alongside Mojo's pilot, Ricochet Rita. The group fled in Mojo's Crossover House and in the ensuing battle with Mojo's forces, escaped into Earth-616, with Rita being captured in the process and secretly converted into "The Agent" and sent after them. The group discovered Kitty Pryde on a train and upon startling her awake, Kitty phased out of the train. The group then had to return Excalibur but had no forms of communication and were being pursued by the Agent, who captured several of the X-Babies by tricking them into signing contracts. This included Colossusus when he attempted to free Dazzler and Rogue from the Agent. He was freed alongside the other X-Babies when Kitty removed the signatures from the contracts. They captured the Agent during a fight between him and the X-Babies and Excalibur and Phoenix restored Rita. The X-Babies agreed to return to Mojo if he gave Rita her freedom. Colossusus and the X-Babies returned to Mojoworld alongside Rita as their guardian and had a list of demands that Mojo had to meet for them to return to work. Some time after this, the X-Babies constructed the Clubhouse for Gifted Youngsters in the Umbrella Forest and were lead by Charlie X who was considered their "Big Brother". Here, the X-Babies tried to save the Pix from the Brotherhood of Mutant Bullies. Failing in their mission the X-Babies returned to their base, only to be attacked and captured by Centennials (Parade balloons turned into Sentinels). The X-Babies were forced to take part in a game show designed by Funhouse (an Evil Baby version of Arcade), which included both quiz and deathtraps. The group failed at the quiz sections but were able to beat the traps and were eventually freed by Cyke and Locksteed. Funhouse threatened to turn the Brotherhood back into neoplasm if the X-Babies did not return and they were about to agree to this when Charlie X showed up with reinforcements and saved the X-Babies.

colt.name: Colt
colt.origin: As a member of Hydra he took care of RJ Boyle's conditioning to make him a merciless Hydra assassin, but thanks to the intervention of the Winter Soldier, RJ managed to overcome Colt's conditioning and lies and apparently eventually killed him. Colt later reappeared alive and well in the Bronx where he commanded a gang of local juveniles in league with Shawn Trella. He shot Derek Lu twice after he tried to quit the job, killing him. colabrun.origin: Doctor Strange blocked some energies fired at him by the humanoid-cat Colàbrun and told him that his realm could not support his presence. Colàbrun declared that each living creature was a fount of psychic wine for him, and it mattered not the type of life. Colàbrun remarked that decision followed hard on sorcery, boasting that Strange would not be able to stop him. Strange called Colàbrun “nether-spawn” as he explained that perhaps this was why he focused his will on confusing Colàbrun’s path back into his realm. Furious, Colàbrun lunged towards Dr. Strange, and then shrieked, as the real Doctor Strange thought to himself that his doppelganger perfectly concealed the portal to the Dimension of No Return, and now Colàbrun would be lost forever within its Loops of Infinity.

combine.name: Combine
combine.origin: The Combine is a composite being made up of former members of the Peace Corpse. As terrorists, they took the Waterwind (a British nuclear submarine) hostage. When their bomb was unintentionally set off, the Peace Corpse members (along with the Avengers, Alpha Flight, People's Protectorate, and various citizens of Atlantis and Canada) were transported to an otherdimensional space via Shaman's Medicine Pouch. There, the nuclear energies combined with alien energies to merge Illyick Prokvitch and Strokov into the Combine. When they made clear their plans to return all affected to Earth where they would carry deadly nuclear radiation, the remaining Peace Corpse members forcibly joined the Combine and convinced them otherwise. Instead, the Combine removed all radiation and began to explore the alien dimensions it now called home.
powers: The Combine was able to generate force fields, use directed energy as a weapon, and absorb radiation.

comet pierce.name: Comet Pierce
comet pierce.origin: Comet Pierce hails from Reality-40800 where by the year 2150, the human race has expanded into the stars. Pierce was a famous space racer, involved in rocket races through space. During a race to the planet Jupiter and back, Pierce's rocket was sabotaged by rival racer Jort, causing him to crash land on an alien world. Comet was rescued by Queen Larania. After he regained consciousness, she told him that she loved him, but she left soon after. Going back to his rocket, Comet found that it had been repaired and equipped with a new and more powerful engine that would allow him to race back to Earth and win the race days ahead of Jort. Comet tracked down the girl that saved his life, revealing that he knew her to be Queen Larania of Martian Zoranthus. Knowing that her world had been taken over by the traitor Golak, Comet pledged to join her cause to free her world and fight in her resistance army.
abilities: Comet is an expert rocket pilot. : Comet knows Gharu sign language.

commander deering.name: Commander Deering
commander deering.origin: Commander Deering was a corrupt U.S. Navy commander who used military drones for smuggling purposes. Victor Mancha hacked into the network his organization used to direct the drone, looking for internet access to find music. The drone mistook Victor's hacked access as the signal point, and thus crashed into the Malibu House where Victor and his friends were staying. Old Lace was killed in the crash, shielding Klara from mortal harm. Pursuing the drone to the crash site, Deering was confronted by Hunter Stein, a tense familiarity evident between the two of them. Hunter lead Victor, his nephew Chase, and the rest of the group to safety. In the process, the Transdimensional Damper the drone had been transporting was used and rendered useless. With no life signs detected, and the package inert, Deering order his men to set the Malibu House ablaze, disposing of any evidence of his wrongdoing.

commissioner reagan.name: Commissioner Reagan
commissioner reagan.origin: The police commissioner of a major city, Reagan had witnessed the execution of gang lord Nick Pinto by electrocution. As a result, when Pinto’s former minion Tony Scarlatti was killed and the murderer identified as being Pinto, Reagan exploded at the chief of detectives Mahoney to find a real, living suspect in the murder case. Scarlatti’s murder was shortly followed by a crime wave that ended when Captain America and Bucky tracked down and rounded up the gang, which included the still-alive Nick Pinto. While the police were unable to make him talk how he escaped death, Reagan nevertheless swore to see Pinto executed again and that he would make certain the gangster stayed dead. Keeping his promise, Reagan sat in on the second electrocution of Nick Pinto, gloating afterwards that they had used enough electrical current to kill an army. He was thus on hand when Pinto, again revived thanks to a corrupt prison mortician, nearly escaped jail only to be revealed by Captain America and Bucky. After Pinto’s latest escape was foiled, this time ending in his true death as he tried to scale an electrified fence, Reagan approached the hero, saying he needed brave men like him on the police force, but Cap demurred, noting he already had a lifetime contract working for Uncle Sam.

composite being.name: Composite Being
composite being.origin: The Composite Being is a cosmic entity who was split into two aspects of good and evil. At some point in his long existence, this being had decided to undergo an experiment to split himself into two beings representing the good and evil aspects of himself named Ahh and Ngh respectively. In addition to the aspects, a set of companions were formed along with the two known as Xa and The Winged Man which proved to be the source of failure in the experiment by containing remnants of good and evil in one another. The good aspects were eventually imprisoned by the Tetrarchs of Entropy while the evil aspects fled to conquer the Dimension of Exile. The Composite Being eventually reformed once more after Ahh convinced Ngh to merge with her, and the being chose to venture out into the cosmos to save and be worshipped by other civilizations after taking away the powers of the Tetrarchs.
powers: Due to possessing the combined powers of his two aspects, the Composite Being possesses the ability to gain strength from the good and evil within other beings in addition to the others listed: Dimensional Travel

comte de nuit.name: Comte de Nuit
comte de nuit.origin: The Comte de Nuit is a French crimefighter and member of Les Heroes de Paris, who became a crimefighter to avenge the murder of his father at the hands of thieves. The Comte de Nuit and his teammates were helped by the Thing in battling the L'Empereur du Monde Souterrain, who wanted to collapse the city of Paris by tunneling under it. Nuit was next seen as a member of France's main black ops team the Le Bureau Discret who was sent to the hilltop borough Montmartre to find their missing teammate Anaïs. Upon their arrival, Nuit and the group happened upon Anaïs's "dead" body in an alleyway. Wondering how this could happen to her, they brought in their specialist, Le Necrogateur to telepathically read her last memories. But de Nuit and the others were ambushed by X-Force before learning Anaïs was only hit with a suspended animation bullet that simulated death. The main target was Necrogateur himself, and X-Force body-slided out of there while leaving the team and Comte de Nuit out cold. At some point, Les Héros de Paris vanished, leaving Paris low on super heroes and vulnerable.

The main target was Necrogateur himself, and X-Force body-slided out of there while leaving the team and Comte de Nuit out cold. At some point, Les Héros de Paris vanished, leaving Paris low on super heroes and vulnerable.
fields.notes: Le Comte de Nuit's appearance and origin would seem to be an homage to the DC Comics hero Batman (Bruce Wayne).

comte de saint germain.name: Comte de Saint Germain
comte de saint germain.origin: ===Early Life=== The Comte de Saint Germain or Count of St. Germain was a European adventurer, with an interest in science and the arts. He achieved prominence in European high society of the mid-18th century. He was considered "one of the greatest philosophers who ever lived". Voltaire to sarcastically dubbed him "The Wonderman". Throughout his life it was speculated he was immortal. ===Modern Era=== In the modern age Saint Germaine travelled to the city of New York sensing an ancient object. He attended the funeral of Professor Brandeis and met Johnny Storm and Sue Storm. Saint Germain claimed to be a colleague of Brandeis. He tried to take the amulet from Brandeis' study but Johnny escaped with it. Comte then sent out a legion of minions after Johnny. The drones attacked Sue but Johnny came to her rescue but was swarmed as well. Max Perish arrived and they escaped in a car. Comte tried to pursue but failed to catch them. When he communicated this telepathically to his employer, Dracula, he was suddenly rocked by a mental pain caused by his master as punishment for his failure.
powers: Saint Germain is immortal, he has been alive for centuries and can recover rapidly from otherwise fatal injuries.
abilities: Saint Germain is fluent in , , , , , and .

conand.name: Conand
conand.origin: According to ancient myths, the warrior king Conand coupled with the primordial Earth Mother Gaea / Domnu and produced the first generation of Fomorians, in the subterranean Dark Realm within Otherworld, though other accounts mention Cichol Gricenchos as the first leader of the Fomorians. Following Gricenchos that went to Ireland ages before (possibly after the Great Cataclysm circa 18,000 BC, Conand and his progeny then left the Dark Realm and traveled through an interdimensional nexus to Earth circa 2300 BC, settling on the Island of the Tower of Glass (modern-days Tory Island, off Ireland's Donegal coast, where the Fomorians came to be worshiped by the Fir Bolg people who inhabited the Irish mainland. Conand was eventually slain, though the accounts vary. He was either killed by the human warrior Fergus Lethderg, or slain by his own angered subjects, because of his unjust rule.

conchita ortiz.name: Conchita Ortiz
conchita ortiz.origin: After his confrontation with Saunders, Frank Castle woke up in a cabin next to Ortiz, who insisted on joining his fight against the Underground Liberation Army and recruiting his wife Conchita, as well. After realizing that the helicopter only had room for two and that Lydia could not fly, Samson pushed her out, shortly before the Punisher shot the pilot Ernie dead, causing them to crash. Samson was left paralyzed, so the Punisher executed him. Conchita attempted to flee with her husband, as police approached them, but the latter died inside of the Underground Liberation Army's truck, while it exploded during a firefight. Conchita killed Mr. Kliegg with a crossbow during the fight. The Punisher and Conchita infiltrated The King's Inn by blowing a hole and ziplining towards the top floor before throwing some of Kingpin's money to people on the ground in order to create a diversion before escaping with the rest. However, Kingpin began chasing their van in his armored "battlebus." As Kingpin continued to chase the Punisher from his battlebus, Brooks and Conchita opened fire on their enemy, while Microchip attempted to invade his system. At a safehouse in New Jersey, the Punisher and his allies planned their next move and predicted Kingpin's. Conchita insisted on killing Kingpin, although the Punisher rejected this proposal. Back at the safehouse, the Punisher rejected Conchita's advances, worried that it might get her killed. After taking a shower, Conchita went downstairs before being shot dead by Mr. Lem, who had located them. Afterwards, the Punisher examined Conchita's corpse and vowed revenge on Kingpin.

conchobar mac nessa.name: Conchobar mac Nessa
conchobar mac nessa.species: Presumably mortal , apotheosized to godhood after his death
conchobar mac nessa.origin: ===Origins=== Conchobar Mac Nessa, also known as Conor Mac Nessa, was the legendary King of Ulster and the leader of the warrior band known as the Red Branch. He reigned from Emain Macha (modern-day Armagh, Northern Ireland) and was the son of Cathbad and the brother of Deichtine. Conchobar fathered the Irish hero Cormac, who later fell under the influence of the Nethergod Necromon and became Cormac the Sword-Master of the Evil Walkers of Otherworld. ===Godhood=== left|thumb|150px|Conor among the Tuatha warriors After his mortal death, he was elevated to godhood and became a member of the Tuatha de Danaan. As a Tuatha warrior, he served under the Dagda and was renowned for possessing the sharpest sight among his peers. ===Modern Age=== Recently, a giant troll, sent by the Fomorians, attacked a Tuatha village in Avalon. In response, the Dagda summoned Conor, Angus, and Cathbad to rally the Tuatha warriors and confront their adversaries. Leading his clan to a cliff overlooking the Fomorians' camp, the Dagda relied on Conor's exceptional sight to assess the situation. From their vantage point, Conor observed a period of quiet until the hot-tempered god Leir impulsively launched a direct assault on the Fomorians. Rather than engaging in direct combat, the Dagda chose a strategic approach, conjuring a swarm of hornets to disperse the enemy and avoid unnecessary bloodshed.

condor delvadian.name: Condor (Delvadian)
condor delvadian.origin: El Condor was a revolutionary operating in Delvadia who named himself after a past revolutionary from the 1930s of the same name that fought in the Delvadian Civil War. As part of his mission, he kidnapped U.S. ambassador Jerome Villiers. When he was attacked by a posse led by representative Keith Bayard, he defeated the posse with his men and captured Bayard. He was about to use helicopters to liberate his people, but was opposed by Daredevil. During the fight, a lightning bolt struck the mountain they were fighting in front of, unleashing an rock slide. Daredevil was able to get to safety, but Condor was buried by the rocks and killed.
abilities: Falconer: El Condor made use of a trained condor.

conductor.name: Conductor
conductor.first_appearance: Silver Surfer: The Best Defense Vol 1 1
conductor.origin: The Conductor was a mysterious god, and the driver of the Train, an equally-mysterious primordial engine of planetary proportions that pulled the worlds in its path into its orbit. After the Conductor's mortal servants and facilitators stripped a world of resources, the Conductor grabbed the planet with its wand and pulled it into the mass of energy that was the Train's furnace to fuel it. The Conductor's labor is endless, and it has driven the Train since before its first memory. After allying himself with the lesser demons Mog'rys and Borss, the villainous Nebulon escaped from Hell. Using a humanoid form, he moved from world to world aboard the Train, killing the Conductor's familiars before revealing his true form and attaching himself to the Conductor's mind. Nebulon then exerted his will on the Conductor to make him shift the Train's course to Earth. thumb|left|Aboard the Train When Galactus and the Silver Surfer stumbled into the Train, he eventually discovered Nebulon's presence, and attempted to fend him off to no avail. He was joined by Namor, who had been rescued by the Silver Surfer's Surfboard from Vodan, an alien planet nearby that was eventually pulled into the Train. They were eventually joined by the Hulk and the astral projection of the Doctor Strange of an alternate future in which the destruction of the Train to stop it from destroying the Earth doomed the planet either way due to the radiation emanated by its destruction. While the Hulk distracted Nebulon by bludgeoning him with the Sufer's board, since the board disrupted the creature's ectoplasmic essence, Strange's astral form slid into the macro-mind of the Conductor. He exerted all of his will to induce a spasm on the giant, causing it to jerk its wand and fling Vodan, the planet on its grasp at the time, into the void of space. This movement caused the Train to shift a fraction of a degree. At the speed and distances involved, this was enough to set the Train off course and miss the Earth. Since this caused Nebulon to fail a deal he and his benefactors had with Mephisto, the demon lord appeared and claimed their souls, detaching Nebulon from the Conductor's mind and freeing it from the monster's influence.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.origin: Conduit was a member of Stryfe's Mutant Liberation Army who traveled along with the others after the temporal storm had past and reconstituted their timeline back to normal. Conduit was led to a underground bunker that belonged to the renegade Cable. They learned that Dayspring had traveled to the past. While they searched the area, Conduit picked up one of the temporal cores not knowing what it was. Later on, the Cronen were able get the portal operational so Conduit followed Stryfe to the incursion point that Cable went to but arrived 18 days before he did. This allowed an agreement to be put into place with the country of Transia where Stryfe would provide them with future weaponry in exchange for a safe haven for all mutants. An army was supposed to be made from the mutants who sought refuge there but with all the fighting within their ranks, Conduit suggested that they put the all of them on the front line and use them as cannon fodder instead. Stryfe considered Conduit's advice but decided to put them in transports and bring them to North Salem. Conduit wondered why North Salem as the town was in ruins but the refuges didn't know that so he asked why to just leave them there with Stryfe responded in order to dig their own graves. Returning to the future, Conduit and Triptych followed Stryfe to Clan Chosen's secret base with the help from Ahab's Hounds. One of them attacked Flintshard which provoked Aliya to try and protect him but Conduit threw his electrically charged baton at Aliya knocking her unconscious. As X-Force defeated the Transian Armed Forces, they traveled down to the subbasement of the Transian Federal House and found an active time portal which Conduit and his teammates came through to bring Cable back to the future. After this a battle broke out between the two groups. Conduit took the fight to Shatterstar using his powered batons against Shatterstar's swords. During the fight, Shatterstar said that getting hit by Conduit's charged batons was like being hit by Thor's hammer which Conduit assured that it was much worse. As the battle was heading in the MLA's favor, the fight ended when Cable surrendered upon learning that the Clan Chosen were being held hostage. After their arrival back to the future, Conduit was present during Cable's interrogation. Cable did not budge at all which resulted in the death of Flintshard. Stryfe gave Cable three mores chances as there where hostages but at Stryfe's command, Conduit electrocuted Cable's synapses with his weapon. Conduit was next seen hiding in patch of woods along with the New Canaanites who were ready to ambush Clan Askani during their trip to Ebonshire.

confucius android.name: Confucius (Android)
confucius android.origin: The Mad Thinker's Confucius android was based upon the Chinese philosopher whose writings on life and spirituality are still revered to this day. The Thinker created this android as part of a group of androids based on great thinkers from history, housed in a laboratory under Ponder, New Hampshire. He hoped that they would be able to make new applications of their philosophies for the modern age, but they were all unable to think outside of their historical context. Considering the androids to be failures, the Mad Thinker began kidnapping living Nobel Prize winners, so he can make android copies of them for a more modern think tank. When Captain America and Team America rescued the Nobel Prize winners, they damaged and disabled Confucius and apparently all the others, who the Thinker was using as henchmen. However, the Mark Twain android was not disabled, and was able to hide himself and several other androids (including Confucius) from the S.H.I.E.L.D clean-up crew, and later he repaired the others. These androids concluded that while the Mad Thinker had provided them with plenty of philosophical knowledge, they knew little about humanity. They were able to pool their resources and contact the Vision, an android with lots of experience with humanity, to teach them. The Vision agreed to teach them, but shortly afterward a damaged Fyodor Dostoyevsky android found them, followed by an angry mob who thought Dostoyevsky was a serial killer, Spider-Man, and the real serial killer. After a large conflict which was eventually resolved when the real serial killer was identified and captured, the androids decided to take Dostoyevsky and retreat into isolation while they considered their next move, instead of continuing their instruction with the Vision. The Mad Thinker eventually returned to the Ponder laboratory and evicted the androids. Many of the androids went on to found the town of Nüponder, Michigan. It is unknown if Confucius was among them.

After a large conflict which was eventually resolved when the real serial killer was identified and captured, the androids decided to take Dostoyevsky and retreat into isolation while they considered their next move, instead of continuing their instruction with the Vision. The Mad Thinker eventually returned to the Ponder laboratory and evicted the androids. Many of the androids went on to found the town of Nüponder, Michigan. It is unknown if Confucius was among them.
fields.notes: Androids build by the Mad Thinker for this project included Confucius, Mark Twain, Fyodor Dostoyevsky, Albert Einstein, William Shakespeare, Plato, Abraham Lincoln, Socrates, Machiavelli, Friedrich Nietzsche, Sigmund Freud, Virginia Woolf, Leonardo da Vinci and other unidentified historical figures. Mark Twain was able to hide and repair Confucius, Einstein, Shakespeare, Lincoln, Freud, Woolf and da Vinci. This group was later joined by Dostoyevsky, who escaped separately. All the other androids were taken away by S.H.I.E.L.D.

congo mort.name: Congo Mort
congo mort.origin: Lorna comes to the rescue of a trapped gorilla caught by Congo Mort, a man who has employed Greg Knight to assist him on his hunt. This put Greg at odds who is at risk of being reported by Mort and lose his job if he does not assist Congo Mort in capturing a gorilla as he had been hired to do. Greg then tells Lorna to get lost, telling her once more that she has no place in the jungle. Lorna goes off into the jungle, knowing that there will be danger and refuses to allow Greg to get harmed and also hopes she can help him and preserve his hunting license as well. Lorna follows after the gorilla on it's path through the jungle. While not far behind, is Congo Mort and Greg are still following. When Mort insists on killing the gorilla, Knight reminds him that his permit was to capture -- not kill -- the gorilla. However Mort insists on killing it, deciding to have the gorilla stuffed instead of selling it to the circus like he planned. When Greg protests, Congo knocks him out and leaves Greg tied to a tree. Elsewhere, Mikki suddenly leaves Lorna, but suspecting that Mikki knows what he is doing, Lorna continues forward. She soon finds the gorilla and its mate. The female gorilla initially attacks Lorna, but she is stopped by the male, who informs her that Lorna saved her life. Meanwhile, Congo Mort is taking the conflict to steal the gorilla's children, but Lorna manages to stop him and ties Mort to a tree. As Lorna drags Mort off to the authorities, she runs into Greg who was freed by Mikki. For the first time in his career, Greg admits that he is glad that Lorna was there to save him.

conn.name: Conn
conn.origin: ===Origin=== Conan was the eldest son of Conan, the Cimmerian king of Aquilonia, and of Queen Zenobia. ===Prince Conn=== Prince Conan was mostly known by his sobriquet, "Conn", and was sometimes named "Prince Conn". After Conan was abducted by the Children of the Blood-Red Doom for his blood to be used to return Razazel, Conn led the Black Dragons to retrieve the King. They arrived in the Temple of Razazel as the moment Conan fell to the Children. The Black Dragons temporary overwhelmed the Children, while securing Conan. The Children soon gained back the upper hand, slaying Dragons while feeding others to their dark lord, until Conan pushed them into the Abyss and prevented Razazel's return. The Aquilonians then returned home. ====Return from Khitai==== During his stay in Khitai, Conn married Li-Tan. Conn returned from Khitai with Rufio, former jester of the late King Aechides of Corinthia. ====War with Argos, Nemedian and Ophir==== That same day, with the help of Rufio, Conan killed the Nemedian assassins dispatched by the conspiration of Queen Leora of Ophir, King Tarascus the Second of Nemedia, and King Xantaus of Argos, while a messenger arrived from Black River Fortress, informing Conan of the Pictish invasion of the Oriskonie province. As Conan and his army went away to crush the Picts, under the command of Xantaus, the armies of Nemedia, Ophir and Argos entered Aquilonia by the eastern border. The invaders captured the messengers sent to warn Conan, but Conn fled the city through a sewer flowing into the Khorotas River shown to him by Hadrathus of the Followers of Asura, discovering Crassus' treason in his escape. ===King Conan II=== After his father abdicated and went on to travel westwards, Conan succeeded him as King Conan II of Aquilonia. Two tales exist to this story: King Conan abdicated in favor of his son and fled westwards to pursue the source of the Red Shadows. King Conan had gone tired with his crown. He attempted to exile Conn for him to earn his crown through adventure and not return before he proved himself. Conn refused, dueled with his father, and finally defeated Conan, and offered Conan his true desire, to return to his adventuring days. Zelata prophesized that Conn would be a greater king than his father. Years later, a party tracking Conan for his son visited Antillia, and kept on westwards until they reached the Island of Golden Ruin, and found the broken sword of Conan. The King sailed to the mouth of the Khorotas River into the Western Sea, and threw his sword at the sea, asking to the waves to carry the unbroken blade to his father. According to another tale, returning from years of travels, Conan joined his son Conan II in a battle against ominous forces that threatened to bring down the whole of the Hyboria n civilization.

connaught.name: Connaught
connaught.origin: Connaught was the manager of Rolwell International Aircraft Co., secretly involved in illicit dealings and determined to obtain the long-lost Odinbolt particle-beam prototype buried in a Greenland glacier since World War II. When the Punisher confronted him at Rolwell's facilities, threatening to expose his criminal activities, Connaught was forced to provide one of the company's top helicopters for the mission. Later, Connaught personally pursued the weapon by air, attempting to seize it for himself after it had been recovered from the glacier. Despite his age, the Punisher managed to activate the particle-beam and shot Connaught down while he was in flight.

connely.name: Connely
connely.origin: Connelly was a Hydra agent who infiltrated S.H.I.E.L.D. He was part of a deep-cover operation working alongside other Hydra sleeper agents within the organization. His cover was eventually blown during the events surrounding the breakout at the Raft and the subsequent investigation into Hydra's infiltration of S.H.I.E.L.D. Connelly was involved in the conspiracy that led to the formation of the New Avengers, as Hydra agents within S.H.I.E.L.D. had been manipulating events from within. He participated in operations related to the Spider-Woman investigation and the broader Hydra plot to destabilize S.H.I.E.L.D. from the inside. His activities were ultimately exposed as part of the revelation that Hydra had successfully placed numerous agents in key positions throughout S.H.I.E.L.D., leading to a major crisis of trust within the intelligence organization.

connie ferrari.name: Connie Ferrari
connie ferrari.origin: left|thumb Connie was a noted defense lawyer in the New York area. She became romantically linked with Steve Rogers. Although the two enjoyed a lengthy relationship, Connie's legal aid to noted criminals such as AIM and her brother David Ferrari eventually became a source of friction between the two, as Steve couldn't reconcile Connie's willingness to allow even such noted criminals their day in court even when he knew that they were guilty of unspeakable crimes. Steve Rogers' mixed emotions towards his former girlfriend Sharon Carter probably did not further their relationship either. After leaving Steve when she found herself unable to cope with the revelation of his real identity as Captain America, Connie was last seen living in Ohio. She had passed the bar in that state and had plans to set up a practice there. Several years later, as a consequence of major shake-ups in Stark Holdings, the ownership of the trademark for the Avengers name was transferred to the only other entity who had also applied for the trademark, Flatman. Connie, who had become the legal representative of the Avengers, attempted to negotiate with him to buy the name back, and Flatman managed to get her to reinstate the Great Lakes Avengers as a permanent and official addition to the Avengers.

connie plepler.name: Connie Plepler
connie plepler.origin: Connie Plepler met her husband when she was working as a cashier at a lamp store he managed. During their relationship, Mr. Plepler sexually harassed her constantly. Together they had a daughter named Daphne. During the dinner when Connie and her husband met Daphne's necromancer boyfriend Michael Hawthorne, Connie choked with a piece of chicken and died when she was alone in the kitchen. Michael found her body and brought it back to life with a spell, turning her into a chicken-obsessed undead who picked up her husband and forced him into sex in revenge for the years of sexual harassment she had to endure. At some point in time, Connie appeared to have become a normal human once again. Together with her husband, she had lunch with Daphne and Michael, an occasion during which Daphne was going to reveal she was expecting a child. However, they were interrupted by the arrival of Michael's friend and ally Deadpool, who took him to have him help in a supernatural emergency at the Monster Metropolis.

connor trevane.origin: Detective Connor Trevane owed Spider-Man for his son, and he told him where to find the Chameleon. Trevane was visited by Arthur Stacy, wanting to know the latest about Spider-Man. He then introduced him to Lieutenant Michael Tork and Detective Snider. Trevane and his partners witnessed Spider-Man battle the Green Goblin in front of the Daily Bugle Building. Some time later, Trevane headed an official Task Force, set up by the Department of Justice to investigate Roxxon Corporation.

connor young.name: Connor Young
connor young.origin: Connor Young was a star basketball player at Woodlawn High, but after passing out on a walk was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis. He was sure his basketball career was over, not helped by needing to sit on the bench for the next game because of his injuries. Stressed because of the comments about him from the crowd and his teammates, he left the gymnasium and made his way to the side of a construction site. While recording a video venting, a strange diamond-shaped object crashed out of the sky, damaging the work site. Connor tried to rescue a construction worker trapped under rubble, but his multiple sclerosis flared up, only for him to touch the fallen artifact. He was transformed into a strange black and silver armored form, rejuvenating him. With his new strength, he rescued the worker, who recognized his resemblance to Darkhawk. Hearing an explosion Connor rushed off, stopping a robbery by three men with high tech weaponry. At home, Connor briefly investigated his powers, realizing he was shorter as Darkhawk. However, he was then called downstairs to inject medicine into his thigh as part of his treatment. His father had to answer the phone and Connor continued alone, only to be struck by a harsh pain. As he cried from the pain the two embraced. Connor’s basketball friend Derek encouraged him to go out to get a newly released sneaker, though Connor voiced concerns because his new medication was expensive and his father still had not been rehired by the school. Derek revealed he would pay, surprising Connor. The pair got the sneakers only for them to be swiped. Derek pursued the thieves, before Connor transformed to help him. Suddenly Derek shot Connor with one of the hi-tech weapon from the robbery, turning him back to his human form. Shocked at the new Darkhawk’s identity, Derek still demanded the armor. Connor refused, urging his friend to leave the gang. The two almost fought, only for the tension to be interrupted by the arrival of Spider-Man. While at the doctors, Connor attempted to reach Derek, but he did not respond to his texts. There Connor learned he seemed to have developed more lesions, and was forced to question if his new powers were hurting his human body. At home he experimented with his powers, learning that his head as Darkhawk was detachable. He was then informed by his coach that Derek was dead. Connor attempted to get information out of Shawn, a former athlete whose career had never taken off, and someone who Connor knew Derek had been working with. conobar.name: Conobar
conobar.origin: Conobar was the son of Conan and Ursla. When Pelon, son of Tolek, aggravated one of the Great White Bears it had to be killed by Conan with the help of other people from Cimmeria. Conobar sensed the death of the polar bear and his followers soon captured Pelon. Conobar quickly figured out that he could not have killed the beast, and Pelon told him that Conan would come soon. Conobar waited for Conan's arrival, which did not take long. Not knowing they were relatives, Conobar challenged him to a duel where he was easily killed. Later, Conan found out he was the father of the man he had just killed and buried him.

conquistador command.name: Conquistador (Command)
conquistador command.origin: Hundreds of years ago, a group of Spanish explorers (including a contingent of soldiers who called themselves Conquistadors) found the Fountain of Eternal Youth in the Florida swamps. The initial group that drank the water were transformed into the ogre-like immortal beings called the Fathers. The remaining members of the party bathed in the water instead, and gained immortality in return for their emotions, but were not physically changed like the Fathers. They founded the village of La Hacienda at the site of the Fountain, and when they discovered they could not leave their village without losing their immortality, they stayed in La Hacienda and cut themselves off from the rest of the world. In the modern era, La Hacienda was discovered by F.A. Schist, which led to a conflict with the Man-Thing that killed several of the Conquistadors. Under unrelieved means, a way was discovered for the inhabitants of La Hacienda to leave the town without losing their immortality and dying. One of the Conquistadors joined The Command, Florida's government-sponsored super-hero team. When the Command was attacked by zombies from Earth-2149, he discovered he was immune to the zombie virus, but he still died when the zombies tore him apart.

conrad meer.name: Conrad Meer
conrad meer.origin: Doctor Agony was a scientist who worked for the Nazis during World War II. He began experimenting on ways to make living creatures immune to pain. His first success was with his pet panther named Tula, who was able to strain her body enough to lift human bodies. For reasons that are unexplained, Tula also developed an ability to put people into trances when she purred, enabling Doctor Agony to force people follow his orders. By 1944, he began human trials of his formula, setting up a secret lab and torture chamber in the hills near an Allied occupied location in Europe. His victims were put to the limits of human endurance pain, but none survived, and Doctor Agony had Tula dispose of the bodies. When Mr. Morley -- an administrator of Allied occupation in Europe -- was captured by Doctor Agony while on a walk, it attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky who began searching for Morley. As Agony experimented on Morley, Tula was sent to dispose of his last victim. Tula was spotted by Cap and Bucky and were attacked by the big cat. The pair were able to fight off the big cat and followed her trail. They walked right into a trap door set by Doctor Agony. Before the two heroes could react, they were subjected to Tula's hypnotic purring. Deciding to test on the two heroes, Agony strapped Bucky to a table to begin operating on him first. Captain America, through sheer willpower, managed to stomp on Tula's tail, causing the cat to stop purring and allowing him to break free from the big cat's hold and attack Doctor Agony. Agony however was prepared for such an attack and dropped a specially designed cage on Captain America. Using the heat elements attached to the bars, Doctor Agony increased the temperature to test Captain America's endurance to heat. While distracted by this, Agony was unable to stop Bucky from breaking free and turning off the heat. While attempting to subdue Bucky, Doctor Agony was unable to prevent Captain America to break out of the cage. Tula then jumped Captain America, and while the hero struggled with the big cat, he struck a light switch. The bright light blinded and disorientated the cat, causing her to attack its own master. Doctor Agony was forced to stab his beloved pet to death to try and save himself; however, his wounds proved fatal, and he bled to death.

conrad shurz.name: Conrad Shürz
conrad shurz.origin: Conrad Shürz served as the co-pilot of the aircraft used by Roger Grafton during his attempt to capture Man-Thing in the Himalayas. During the expedition, Shürz assisted in the effort to secure the creature, including operating the cage that was intended to imprison it. As an avalanche devastated the hidden Snowmen valley, Shürz and pilot Billy Ellenshaw escaped aboard their aircraft. Once airborne, the pair became concerned when the plane appeared unable to gain altitude properly and handled as though it were carrying a far heavier load than expected. The explanation remained unknown to them: Man-Thing had attached himself to the aircraft's landing gear while supporting Elaine Simpson beneath him. The extra weight disappeared when the intense cold caused the swamp creature's arm to break away from its body, sending both Man-Thing and Elaine falling into the mountains below. Freed of the unexpected burden, the aircraft resumed normal flight and departed the area.

conscience.name: Conscience
conscience.origin: Conscience was a special robot created by Master Mold when its memory-engrams were that of Steven Lang. Master Mold felt too lonely and built a special robot who could feel emotions. Conscience was also built with Lang's memory-engrams. Conscience would be an accomplice of Master Mold during his plan to create and spread the Retribution virus, which stopped mutants from using their powers and then killed them. The Retribution virus was created by Moira MacTaggart under Master Mold's influence. However, Banshee and Cyclops discovered what happened. Master Mold infected and kidnapped Banshee and a mutant girl, but could not defeat Cyclops. Cyclops freed MacTaggart and tried to protect her while she was developing a cure. Master Mold sent an army of robots, led by Conscience, to invade Muir Island. Conscience defeated Cyclops, MacTaggart and their ally Callisto. Both Cyclops and Callisto were infected, and then led to Master Mold alongside MacTaggart. Then, Master Mold and Conscience discovered that the virus had mutated and was also lethal to human beings. Master Mold insisted on using it anyhow, assuming that a small number of humans would survive; then, the Sentinels could control them to avoid the birth of new mutants. Conscience, being emotional, decided that it would be unfair. Conscience fought and destroyed Master Mold, sacrificing itself, to avoid this scenario. Master Mold has returned since, but Conscience was truly dead. Apparently, Conscience managed to get a victory by destroying the Retribution virus.

conserve and protect.name: Conserve And Protect
conserve and protect.origin: The C.A.P., short for "Conserve and Protect", was a peacekeeping robot designed by Ted Castle for use on Nu-World. However, a flaw in the robot's programming caused him to activate prematurely while he still on Earth, after Castle and Mister Fantastic mentioned law-enforcement officers near him. Due to the flaw, he began attacking indiscriminately anything he considered a threat, no matter how insignificant. He proved overwhelmingly powerful and was able to defeat even all of America's heroes working together. Ultimately, Mister Fantastic used his ultrapowerful Anti-Galactus Suit to both attract and destroy the robot.

constable trueheart.name: Constable Trueheart
constable trueheart.origin: thumb|left|150pxWhile in a bar in the most infamous part of a city on the planet Degenera, congratulating himself on the wallets he'd stolen, Pip the Troll was approached by Constable Trueheart, who stopped him and told him about the series of thefts that had occurred in the city since his arrival. Pip, with an innocent look, replied that he hoped he wouldn't suspect him, and also told him that it was true that the bar was full of crooks, such as Sheila Sweethips, who, while beautiful, was corrupt and dishonest, or Fast Eddie, the cleverest criminal in the cosmos. Meanwhile, Pip was also robbing Trueheart, and when he realized what was happening, he tried to arrest him, but Pip had also taken his belt, leaving Trueheart with his pants down, unable to reach him.

constance molina.name: Constance Molina
constance molina.origin: In the 1970s, Constance Molina was a reporter for numerous tabloids, specially focusing on sightings of metahumans. On November 7, 1972, detective James Lucas discovered the corpse of a bat-like monster, and Constance offered to help him, by contacting him with Adam Brashear. thumb|left|Contance in the 70s When she, Lucas and Brashear arrived to the morgue where the body was being kept, they discovered Blade fighting Kaluu. The fight was stopped, and as they began investigating, the Bear appeared, and presented herself as the killer of that creature, in self-defense, as she wanted to prevent the Deathwalkers from using it for a sacrifice. The Bear explained that she herself was the result of a failed attempt of the Deathwalkers to extinguish humanity in 1908, and that they would try to do it again. With the mystery solved, the people present formed the Mighty Avengers, and went to find the Deathwalkers. Kaluu tracked down the magic they used in the were-bat to a secret subway below the City Hall. The Mighty Avengers then attacked the Deathwalkers before they could make their sacrifice. After Blade recovered the Talisman of Kamar-Taj, which was required to perform the sacrifice, Adam Brashear caused the subway to collapse above the Deathwalkers. With the Deathwalkers stopped, the team disbanded. In the present day, Constance and Kaluu returned to New York City in order to contact Luke Cage's Mighty Avengers, and inform them that the Deathwalkers had returned.

fields.history: In the 1970s, Constance Molina was a reporter for numerous tabloids, specially focusing on sightings of metahumans. On November 7, 1972, detective James Lucas discovered the corpse of a bat-like monster, and Constance offered to help him, by contacting him with Adam Brashear. thumb|left|Contance in the 70s When she, Lucas and Brashear arrived to the morgue where the body was being kept, they discovered Blade fighting Kaluu. The fight was stopped, and as they began investigating, the Bear appeared, and presented herself as the killer of that creature, in self-defense, as she wanted to prevent the Deathwalkers from using it for a sacrifice. The Bear explained that she herself was the result of a failed attempt of the Deathwalkers to extinguish humanity in 1908, and that they would try to do it again. With the mystery solved, the people present formed the Mighty Avengers, and went to find the Deathwalkers. Kaluu tracked down the magic they used in the were-bat to a secret subway below the City Hall. The Mighty Avengers then attacked the Deathwalkers before they could make their sacrifice. After Blade recovered the Talisman of Kamar-Taj, which was required to perform the sacrifice, Adam Brashear caused the subway to collapse above the Deathwalkers. With the Deathwalkers stopped, the team disbanded. In the present day, Constance and Kaluu returned to New York City in order to contact Luke Cage's Mighty Avengers, and inform them that the Deathwalkers had returned.

constance rand.name: Constance Rand
constance rand.origin: thumb|left Constance Rand (née Dean) was the mother of Ka-Zar (David Rand) and wife of John Rand, the wealthy owner of a diamond field in Transvaal. In 1921, while on a flight with her husband and their son from Johannesburg to Cairo, their plane crashed in the Belgian Congo. They were stranded in the jungle attempting to get the attention of rescue planes but to no avail. Eventually, Constance succumbed to a jungle fever and died. She was buried in the jungle and her son David lined her grave with some of the most exotic flowers he could find in the jungle. John continued to raise their son in the jungle until he was murdered by jewel hunter Paul de Kraft. David was adopted by the lion known as Zar and grew up to the became the legendary hero Ka-Zar.

constantius.name: Constantius
constantius.origin: Constantius, the Falcon, was the Supreme Commander of an army of Shemite mercenaries, and leader of the Free Companies. He met Salome the Witch, who wanted the throne of Khauran, then held by her twin sister Taramis. Salome understood that Constantius was lacking of any sign of goodness, so she chose him as help for her plans of conquer. Constantius approached Khauran with his army, faking heading to Turan. Once having met the Queen Taramis he pretended to ask her hand. Taramis refused his marriage proposal, but agreed at the passage of Constantius' troops though, as warranty, she held Constantius in one of the tower rooms until his army had passed over the town of Khauran. That night, Salome impersonating her sister Taramis the Queen, entered in the town and had the Shemite mercenaries enter the town. Salome also had Constantius freed from his prison, then drove him to meet Taramis. Salome told her past and her plans to her sister. Then she let Constantius abuse Taramis, before imprisoning her in a hidden prison. Salome, impersonating Taramis, declared to the Khauran people that she had accepted the Constantius' marriage proposal, and released the Khauran army. Conan of Cimmeria, Captain of the Guards, realized that she was not Taramis and claimed the fact in front of the crowd. Taramis had the Shemites attack Conan, the Khauran Guards tried to defend themselves but eventually they were defeated and Conan overpowered. Constantius and the Shemites took control over the town. The Falcon crucified Conan in the desert. Constantius married Salome. Salome's reign became depraved and dissolute. The Shemite troops humiliated every nomad they desired. The people were heavily taxed and vexed. Many young Khaurans were sold as slaves, others fled, joining to the nomads of the desert. Constantius set a web of spies in the town. The nomads, stronger than ever, started to raid the villages. The Shemite troops defended only the capital and the nearest territories. A revolt arose in Khauran, led by Marcios, once a Khauran soldier, but it failed and he had to flee and hide. About seven months after Constantius invaded Khauran, they captured and beheaded Krallides, Taramis' most faithful counselor. A week later, Conan, having survived the cross and now leader of more than 11,000 Zuagir nomad warriors, headed to Khauran with his army. Constantius gathered his cavalry and went out of the town to attack the Nomads and destroy their siege machines. Constantius had his army charge against the Zuagirs; but he didn't know that Conan had the help of 3,000 Khauran knights, hidden behind the Zuagir lines, and that the siege machines were false. The Zuagirs seemed to tremble under the Shemite attack. Then their lines opened and 3,000 Hyborian knights, full of hate and desperation, charged, taking Constantius of surprise. Khumbanigash, the Shemites' General, was killed. The Shemite army was defeated. Constantius ran away with a handful of knights, leaving his men to die outside the wall of the city. His purpose was to close the town gates and keep control of the town. Meanwhile, in the capital city, Marcios' spies had spread the news that the real queen was alive and that they had to revolt against Constantius. The Falcon arrived at the temple and found Conan and Taramis and Marcios alive. The people were uncertain. Salome appeared, wounded, calling Thaug. Understanding that the falsehood was over, Constantius had his men shoot arrows on Conan. The people, understanding that their real queen was alive, assaulted the Shemite mercenaries. Constantius was captured by the people of Khauran. Salome died, Thaug, her huge demon went out of the temple, and at his sight the Shemites fled. Thaug was killed by Conan and his Desert Wolves. Taramis was restored on her throne, and Constantius was crucified by Conan.

consultant.name: Consultant
consultant.origin: ===Origins=== The Consultant was a criminal consultant, helping villains increase their power and rep levels. Some of his clients included Boomerang, Grizzly, and Armadillo. ===Mr. Pain=== He helped Vince Dio become the super criminal Mr. Pain. However when he didn't pay the agreed fees, the Consultant wanted revenge. He decided to use criminal Jack Dio as a new operative. ===Hippo=== He posed as the Hippo to gain entry to solitary confinement in the Cage. His cell was next to Jackie's. He encouraged him to visit the Consultant, but he had no interest. He then posed as a patient harmed by Mr. Pain at the hospital where Dio had been admitted. The patient claimed that the Consultant had been responsible for enhancing Pain and advised Dio to do the same, but he refused. The Consultant then tipped Dio off on one of the Owls' operations, knowing it would lead Dio to be in contact with the SS2 gas. ===SS2=== He posed as a doctor when Jackie was infected by the SS2 gas, a variant of the Super-Soldier Serum. He tested Jackie's reflexes by firing on him. He got a shot that cleared up Jackie's dizziness, but hampered his vision, so he gave Jackie a special set of sunglasses that would help. He then subtly offered information about the Owls' operations to Jackie. He slipped a card advertising the Mechanic to Jackie, who was soon hurt in a fight with Grizzly and Boomerang. Jackie went to the Mechanic for new weapons. ===Mechanic=== As the Mechanic, he showed Jackie how to use his special glasses and equipped him with special guns with Adamantium bullets. He posed as a doctor in a prison hospital after Jackie Dio was shot by several cops. Wanting a monetary return on his investment he injected him with a Healing factor to save him from death. He left behind a note stated he needed payment. After Jackie finally killed Mr. Pain, the Consultant revealed himself, told Jackie to take the codename Underworld, and demanded payment soon. After all this he continued with his work with his next client, the Armadillo.

controller thirteen.name: Controller-Thirteen
controller thirteen.origin: Controller numbered Thirteen was part of the underground organization of sadistic voyeurs known as the Theatre of Pain, turning the physical and emotional anguish of others into profit. Controller-13 had his nerves deadened, making him incapable of feeling emotion or pain. This made him the perfect handler for La Lunatica, a mutant psycho-vampire who fed on the emotional turmoil of others. For ten years, Luna served Controller-13 as his slave thanks to an obedience collar. Their "art" involved Luna's touch unleashed the buried emotional scars of test subjects, allowing Controller-13's machines to psychically record these memories and the emotions attached to them. Controller-13's reach exceeded his grasp when he had Luna capture the X-Men. Timothy Fitzgerald's explosive energy release destroyed the Dark Room's equipment and shorted out Luna's collar, allowing her to finally take revenge on Controller 13.

cookie malone.name: Cookie Malone
cookie malone.origin: Cookie Malone was the cook in British Columbia where James Howlett, renamed Logan after his arrival, came with Rose to work after Logan was expelled from the Howlett estate by his grandfather. The foreman there was Smitty who was a gruff man, but he was fair. Cookie was obese while all the other men there were extremely thin, so they often said that he stole extra rations. He took an instant disliking to Logan and continually hurt him, until Smitty came to his rescue. As Logan became well loved and called either "Little Smitty" or "Wolverine", Cookie became less popular among the men which angered him. One day, Smitty taught Logan to use explosives and Cookie shortened the fuses so that Logan would run out of time to get out before the dynamite blew. While this resulted in the deaths of five men, Logan survived and was able to shield a young boy from the blast too. While graves for the deceased were dug, Cookie stole their possessions. Logan approached him and made him expose himself as the fraud he was which just made matters between them worse. Cookie cut Rose and Logan's rations, resulting in Logan hunting deer in the woods and giving the extra to the neighbors which made him more beloved. In a cage match held at a bar, Cookie fought Logan. A hooded figure, who was actually Dog Logan gave Cookie brass knuckles to hurt Logan with but Logan being quite a formidable opponent at the time, won easily. After Rose's death, he is seen going through her belongings for things of value. He throws her diary and important letter written to James, Logan, into the fire.
abilities: Adequate cook.
weaknesses: Extreme jealousy, gluttony, greed, lack of compassion/empathy, lack of a formal education.

cookie novak.name: Cookie Novak
cookie novak.origin: ===Origins=== Cookie Novak was a soldier in the United States Army who served in during World War II and the Korean War. Not much is known about his past, except that he is a Polish immigrant. This likely was his motivation for fighting in World War II as his mother still lived in Poland. ===World War II=== During World War II, Cookie Novak met and fought alongside Hank "Combat" Kelly usually under the command of Captain Thorn and Sargent O'Hooligan. He also fought frequently with Captain Thorn's Baker Company. On March 1, 1943, Combat and Cookie were were among a unit that clashed with Erwin Rommel's Afrika Corps, beating them to a strategic watering hole. April 7th that same year, the pair were part of the America II Corps that were stationed in Africa, where they clashed again with the Nazi's Afrika Corps and Erwin Rommel. They located a secret bunker where Rommel and his troops hid their tanks between attacks and marked it for American bombers. On January 22, 1944, Combat and Cookie were shipped to Anzio, Italy, where they fought alongside the 5th Armored Division as part of Operation: Shingle. There they foiled a plot by the Nazis to use miniaturized tanks filled with explosives. On February 1st 1944, Combat and Cookie were part of the 5th Army Division and assisted in clearing out Nazi forces that had holed up in St. Benedict's Cathedral in Italy. During the spring, Combat and Cookie were under the command of Captain Thorn in the 34th Infantry Division (the Sandstorm Division), battling Nazi forces in Italy, and wrecking an enemy supply line headed for Rome. Later in their first recorded mission with Baker Company, Combat and Cookie managed to incapacitate an entire army of Nazis with wine found in a wine cellar in a small Italian village. On June 6, 1944, Combat and Cookie were part of the 29th Blue Grey Division, seeing action 17 miles off the coast of Omaha with Nazi forces. They were captured but freed by the French "rat run" that helped freed captured Allied soldiers. On June 11th 1944, Combat and Cookie crossed paths with a Nazi supply truck shipping the Nazis new V-1 rockets, destroying a large supply of them. Finding the launching site, the pair then sabotaged the rockets. The next day when the Nazis attempted to launch the rockets at London, most ended up striking Berlin instead, with only one hitting London. Embarrassed by this defeated, Adolf Hitler ordered a cover up of the failure. In August of that year, Combat and Cookie were instrumental in helping Allied Forces break past the Nazi's Siegfried Line through France. Later that month, the pair were part of the 90th Infantry Division (The Alamo Infantry) where they destroyed Nazi tanks poised to attack American positions. In July of that year, Combat and Cookie were in Livorno (Leghorn) Italy destroying Nazi jets. During this operation they had the incredible luck of capturing Adolf Hitler while fleeing enemy forces. They then forced Hitler to bring them to various air bases and order the troops there to destroy them. With their mission completed this way, they then shaved off Hitler's mustache and dressed him up in a GI uniform and turned him over to Nazi authorities as an "American soldier" and escaped while Hitler was left to prove who he really was. Relocating to Sicily, Combat and Cookie made a bet with British and Canadian soldiers that they could liberate the town of Messina before they could. Sure enough on July 10, 1944 the pair managed to overcome great odds to get to the town first and clear it of Nazi forces before their fellow Allies. On July 17, 1944, Combat and Cookie were stationed in the Pacific Theatre where they assisted in the liberation of Onna Atoll, and later Kawawa Atoll, from Imperial Japanese forces. By November 8, 1944, Combat and Cookie were stationed in Africa where they foiled Nazi tank attacks during Operation Torch. In December 1944, Combat and Cookie clashed with Nazi ski patrols in the mountains of Italy. Shortly thereafter they were redeployed to Bastogne, Belgium where they used Jerry cans of gasoline to destroy Nazi tanks. After this battle Combat was awarded the Silver Star from General S. Patton himself. In February of 1945, Combat and Cookie returned to Europe where they were part of the 29th Blue Grey Division clashing with Nazi forces along the Rhine River where they uncovered that the twin brother of Sargent Bonner had kidnapped and took his brothers place in order to report their troop movements to the Nazis. Combat and Cookie rescued the Sargent and sent his brother back to the Nazis where he was executed for his failures. In March of that year, Combat, Cookie and Captain Thorne were smuggled into Hamburg, Germany. There they worked with Agent K, an Allied spy, to dismantle a group of loyal Nazis called the Wolves who were attempted to refortify the Nazis who were then losing ground in Germany. On April 28, 1945, Combat and Cookie were back in Italy clashing again with Nazi forces. Along the way

In July of that year, Combat and Cookie were in Livorno (Leghorn) Italy destroying Nazi jets. During this operation they had the incredible luck of capturing Adolf Hitler while fleeing enemy forces. They then forced Hitler to bring them to various air bases and order the troops there to destroy them. With their mission completed this way, they then shaved off Hitler's mustache and dressed him up in a GI uniform and turned him over to Nazi authorities as an "American soldier" and escaped while Hitler was left to prove who he really was. Relocating to Sicily, Combat and Cookie made a bet with British and Canadian soldiers that they could liberate the town of Messina before they could. Sure enough on July 10, 1944 the pair managed to overcome great odds to get to the town first and clear it of Nazi forces before their fellow Allies. On July 17, 1944, Combat and Cookie were stationed in the Pacific Theatre where they assisted in the liberation of Onna Atoll, and later Kawawa Atoll, from Imperial Japanese forces. By November 8, 1944, Combat and Cookie were stationed in Africa where they foiled Nazi tank attacks during Operation Torch. In December 1944, Combat and Cookie clashed with Nazi ski patrols in the mountains of Italy. Shortly thereafter they were redeployed to Bastogne, Belgium where they used Jerry cans of gasoline to destroy Nazi tanks. After this battle Combat was awarded the Silver Star from General S. Patton himself. In February of 1945, Combat and Cookie returned to Europe where they were part of the 29th Blue Grey Division clashing with Nazi forces along the Rhine River where they uncovered that the twin brother of Sargent Bonner had kidnapped and took his brothers place in order to report their troop movements to the Nazis. Combat and Cookie rescued the Sargent and sent his brother back to the Nazis where he was executed for his failures. In March of that year, Combat, Cookie and Captain Thorne were smuggled into Hamburg, Germany.
